subject: Provisioning lane lock request — EchoAI late-stage capacity
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@echoai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisioning lane lock request — EchoAI late-stage capacity

Team,

EchoAI (Lena) confirmed a late-stage commitment for their enterprise contract and asked us to place a provisional provisioning lane lock while they complete final legal/procurement steps. High-level ask: get a temporary reservation for the week of 7/20 — 8/2 to guarantee throughput for their workload during onboarding. They will need a mix of A100-40GB and A100-80GB equivalents with peak concurrent capacity to sustain ~1200 tokens/sec across multiple clients during pilot.

Can infra confirm whether we have a contiguous provisioning lane that can be held for a 14-day window? Rishi — please include the current tentative schedules for nodes in us-west and whether any rebalancing would be needed.

I've attached a draft provisioning plan and a requested GPU matrix from EchoAI. EchoAI is asking for a single-point response for procurement (they want a line they can reference). We should provide a clear temporary hold timeframe and the fallback if we can't fully block the lane.

Next actions suggested:
- Rishi: inventory + impact on existing commitments (ETA EOD).
- Neha: confirm whether we can offer an explicit provisional hold in HubSpot (and how long before triggering billing).
- Laura: loop in Sales Ops for any discount/commit ask tied to the hold.

Thanks — Marcus

Attachment: provisioning_plan_v2.pdf (pdf, 560KB)
Attachment: requested_gpu_matrix.csv (csv, 12KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@echoai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning lane lock request — EchoAI late-stage capacity

Marcus — quick inventory snapshot below.

Summary (current us-west pool):
- Immediate free capacity: 4x A100-80GB nodes, 6x A100-40GB nodes (non-contiguous across clusters cw1/cw2).
- Potential to free contiguous lane of 3xA100-80GB + 4xA100-40GB with minor reschedules (non-disruptive for low-priority test tenants) — estimated 48-72 hours to move workloads and validate.
- No current hard commitments that would block a 14-day provisional hold, but we have queued customer ramp actions next month that would require re-evaluation if hold extends past 8/2.

Questions/risks:
1) EchoAI's matrix shows peak concurrent sustained utilization that would benefit from KV-cache pinning — do we need to reserve extra memory for prewarm?
2) If procurement slips >7 days, we should define a demobilization SLA to free the lane without impacting higher-SLA customers.

I'll produce a short playbook with the exact nodes and expected reschedule timeline by 16:00 PT. If Sales wants a firm provisioning lane (contiguous nodes), we can do it but will need approval to bump a low-priority staging tenant for 48–72 hours.

Rishi

Attachment: node_snapshot_us-west-20260714.xlsx (xls, 80KB)
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@echoai.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: EchoAI Procurement <procurement@echoai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning lane lock request — EchoAI late-stage capacity

Thanks Marcus and Rishi — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from our side:

- The pilot start is scheduled for 7/27 with a hard business KPI window through 8/10. We truly need guaranteed contiguous capacity for the initial two-week window (7/27–8/09).
- Preferred GPU mix: 6x A100-80GB (primary), 6x A100-40GB (secondary). If full contiguous for all 12 isn't possible, EchoAI will accept contiguous primary (6x80GB) + best-effort for the 40GBs provided we can burst.
- Procurement timeline: we expect PO to be signed by 7/22; there is a small chance legal pushes to 7/26.

If you can provide a provisional lane confirmation and an identifier we can reference in our PO, that helps speed procurement. Happy to take the temporary hold fee language if you have standard verbiage.

— Lena
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena@echoai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisioning lane lock request — EchoAI late-stage capacity

Quick note on process:

- We can issue a provisional provisioning lane hold in HubSpot tied to the deal record (ECHO-2026-0047). Standard provisional holds are non-billable for up to 10 calendar days. Beyond that we have a temporary hold fee tier (50% of one-month reserved rate pro-rated) unless a firm commitment is executed.
- If EchoAI needs the full 14 days guaranteed, procurement can accept the temporary hold fee; we should confirm discount eligibility with Sales Ops.
- For the node mapping I'll rely on Rishi's playbook. Please attach the exact nodes that will be reserved so we can reflect them in the hold description.

For Sales Ops / Legal: are we okay publishing the temporary hold fee in-line with prior precedent?

Neha

Lena — thanks. Here's what we can commit now based on Rishi's initial playbook and Neha's temporary-hold guidance:

Commitment (provisional):
- Contiguous provisioning lane: 6x A100-80GB nodes reserved in us-west (7/25–8/09) — will be held pending either PO receipt or temporary-hold fee confirmation.
- Best-effort for A100-40GB nodes: up to 6x available with burst windows; we'll guarantee burst capacity but not contiguous placement for the second tier.
- Provisioning-hold identifier: PRV- ECHO-4721 (reference this in the PO).
- If PO is signed by 7/22, the hold will convert to a normal reserved commitment per the deal terms. If procurement slips beyond 7/26, temporary hold fees apply per Neha's note.

Next steps:
- Rishi: finalize exact node ids and schedule reschedule jobs (deliverable: node list + maintenance window by 7/16 16:00 PT).
- Neha: create the provisional hold in HubSpot and send hold fee wording to EchoAI procurement.
- Laura: confirm any discount runway we can offer if EchoAI converts to reserved commit within 30 days.

Lena — I'll follow up with a short doc that lists the PRV id and the node mapping once Rishi confirms.

Marcus
